reason: The existing mapping of Articles 9, 15, and 17 provides a defensible and sufficiently complete regulatory basis for the control objective. Article 15(4) explicitly requires technical redundancy solutions, which include backup or fail-safe plans, directly addressing capacity, redundancy, and fail-safe. Article 9 mandates a comprehensive risk management system, which inherently covers recovery planning and testing. Article 17 requires a quality management system that includes the risk management system from Article 9, ensuring a structured approach to resilience. Together, these provisions cover all aspects of the control statement.
